extraction.notes: No summer camp program could be verified from readable official pages. The church's Facebook page returned no readable content. A third-party mirror of Facebook posts includes a June 30, 2026 fundraiser mentioning Vacation Bible School, but no dates, ages, hours or program details were found. This is a lead for manual follow-up, not enough to create a verified card. No 2027 camp information or registration announcements were found.
